## 更新内容

3.0.3 适配 deew 5.3.1，并修复低响度音轨只测量失败的问题。升级后最低要求 **deew 5.3.1**；请替换 CLI 版 `deew.exe`，保留原 `config.toml` 和完整 DEE 工具集。仍要求授权 DEE ≥6.7.0，推荐 truehdd ≥0.6.3、dee_shim ≥0.2.0。

- **支持新版测量流程**：TrueHD Atmos 只测量按输入选择 `truehdd` 和 `dee_measure_loudness`，不再要求 DDP Atmos 编码器；测量 Atmos 母版的多声道响度，跳过双耳响度结果。
- **修复低响度测量**：只测量模式保留低于 −31 dB 的有效结果，避免较安静的音轨被误判为失败；运行进度、结果和任务历史均保留该值。
- **补齐编码选项与依赖检查**：新增关闭环绕声 90° 相移的 `-nps` 选项；AC4 Atmos 的 DRC 默认值改为 `none`；88.2/96 kHz 输入转 TrueHD 时，启动前检查 `dee_shim`。
- **显示更多响度信息**：界面、MCP 查询和任务历史保留节目响度、语音占比、响度范围及真峰值等上游提供的指标。
- **整理说明文字**：润色界面提示、帮助、README、官网及发布说明，保留操作条件、兼容要求和已知限制。

验证：629 项普通回归、23 组真实短样本全部通过，桌面及 MCP Release 编译通过。96 kHz TrueHD 解码后的 PCM 与源 PCM 逐字节一致。**真实 TrueHD Atmos 测量和 Atmos 编码仍待素材验收**；依赖与子进程测试不能替代真实媒体验证。详见 [验收记录](https://github.com/frankie1024/FlowEncode/blob/v3.0.3/docs/DEEW531-VALIDATION.md)。

提供 Windows x64 安装包、便携 ZIP 和 SHA256 校验文件。

## Update Notes

3.0.3 adds support for deew 5.3.1 and fixes measure-only failures on quiet audio. **deew 5.3.1 or newer is now required**. Replace the CLI `deew.exe` while keeping your existing `config.toml` and complete DEE toolset. Licensed DEE ≥6.7.0 is still required; truehdd ≥0.6.3 and dee_shim ≥0.2.0 are recommended.

- **Support the updated measurement flow**: TrueHD Atmos measure-only tasks select `truehdd` and `dee_measure_loudness` based on the input and no longer require the DDP Atmos encoder. Measurement uses the multichannel Atmos master and skips binaural loudness results.
- **Fix quiet-source measurement**: measure-only tasks retain valid results below −31 dB instead of reporting failure. Live progress, results and task history preserve these values.
- **Update encoding options and dependency checks**: add the `-nps` option to disable the surround 90° phase shift; use `none` as the default AC4 Atmos DRC; check for `dee_shim` before encoding 88.2/96 kHz input to TrueHD.
- **Expose more loudness information**: the interface, MCP queries and task history retain upstream metrics including program loudness, speech percentage, loudness range and true peak.
- **Clarify documentation and messages**: polish interface messages, help, READMEs, the website and release notes while preserving operating conditions, compatibility requirements and known limitations.

Validation: all 629 regression tests and 23 real short-sample tasks passed; desktop and MCP Release builds passed. Decoded 96 kHz TrueHD PCM matched the source PCM byte for byte. **Real TrueHD Atmos measurement and Atmos encoding still await media acceptance testing**; dependency and subprocess tests do not replace real-media validation. See the [validation record](https://github.com/frankie1024/FlowEncode/blob/v3.0.3/docs/DEEW531-VALIDATION.md).

Windows x64 installer, portable ZIP and SHA256 checksums are provided.
